description: Publish or unpublish a side page. published:true publishes the CURRENT DRAFT — it sets the published pointer to the latest draft version, which is how you make draft edits (from edit_side_page / set_side_page_section) live. published:false hides the page publicly but keeps the last-published version marker, so re-publishing with no further edits restores it instantly. The response includes `publishedVersionId` — the version now live (unchanged from before on unpublish) — so you know exactly which version is public without a follow-up view_side_page call.

sideKey.description: Side page key — the slug as returned by list_side_pages. A nested key containing "/" (e.g. "features/feature-1") is passed as-is; the server handles the URL encoding.

name: set_side_page_state
